description: Tuesday 12:38: Claire uploads two photos to the shared Living room folder and writes nothing: IMG_0418.jpg, her mother's secretary standing at the window end of the long wall, and IMG_0419.jpg, the movers' tag on its key (W 38"). Tuesday 14:10: Claire rings Priya for one Arlo side table, not the pair; Priya logs the call under Calls with Claire on Jessica's Living room notes page in Notion and leaves the order list's Arlo row at 2 for Jessica to decide. Nothing announces either.
